source_plan.formats: Published HTML documents, subsequently frozen as attributed text. PDF/DOCX extraction is outside this first fixed-context benchmark.
source_plan.adaptation_rule: Original document wording is preserved. Questions may require calculations from cited values; hypothetical inputs must be explicitly identified in the question. No invented source passages or manufactured conflicts.

splits.development: Used for prompt, verifier and implementation choices.
splits.reserved: Question, source and gold revisions frozen before evaluation. No tuning or selective reruns using reserved results.
splits.claim_limit: Reserved project evaluation, not independently authored or model-pretraining-unseen. Public documents may be present in model training.
splits.after_exposure: Record every evaluation access. If reserved outcomes inform changes, retire that evaluation round; report later runs as exposed regression results or create a new untouched evaluation set.

run_plan.note: Counts assume one generation call per job and no verifier. Additional stage calls are logged separately. No model call is made by design validation. Repeated trials and shuffled orders require a separately agreed run plan.
run_plan.empty_context_controls: Optional zero-model-call software controls; never counted as successful model abstentions.

readiness_requirements: Owner accepts source selection and split proposal
Redistribution terms and attribution verified per source; exclude third-party media
Source bytes and extracted text captured and SHA-256 recorded
60 unique questions authored with atomic response units and exact supporting spans
Unanswerable labels checked against the entire declared source scope, not only retrieved text
Document-family split and category quotas validated
Gold annotations adjudicated before model output is inspected
Prompt, generation options, model digests and retrieval settings locked separately before execution
results_policy: Append raw outputs and stage logs. Never replace failed outputs with favorable reruns. Preserve existing published experiments unchanged.
